texts.text_span: Gordon developed from a tropical wave that moved off the west coast of Africa on 9 September. The wave produced heavy rains and gusty winds over portions of the Cabo Verde Islands on 10 September. Showers and thunderstorms started to become more organized around a well-defined center early on 11 September, and a tropical depression formed by 1200 UTC that day, about 200 n mi west of the Cabo Verde Islands.

texts.text: Gordon developed from a tropical wave that moved off the west coast of Africa on 9 September. The wave produced heavy rains and gusty winds over portions of the Cabo Verde Islands on 10 September. Showers and thunderstorms started to become more organized around a well-defined center early on 11 September, and a tropical depression formed by 1200 UTC that day, about 200 n mi west of the Cabo Verde Islands.

The estimated minimum central pressure of 1004 mb is based on the Knaff-Zehr- Courtney pressure-wind relationship.
